messages:
tara_support: @alex_chang customer AcmeHR reporting tokens/sec gaps in Console around 15:12-15:14 UTC — chart shows missing points (null) instead of 0. https://console.redwood.io/orgs/acmehr/dashboards/streaming
alex_chang: can you paste the query/filter and customer id?
tara_support: route=ingest-01, api_key=acme-hr-prod, timeframe last 30m. Query: `GET /api/metrics?metric=tokens_per_sec&route=ingest-01&window=60s`
jordan_eng: do we have ingester/emitter logs for that route? ingester looked steady earlier but rebalances can cause transient gaps. @ingest-bot any recent rebalances for acme-ingest-01?
ingest-bot: consumer-group acme-ingest-01 rebalanced at 1715554260; assignments changed: partition 2 moved pod-12 -> pod-14. logs excerpt: `WARN kv-consumer: lost partition 2, reason=rebalance`
ingest-bot: metrics-emitter logs around that time: `INFO metrics-emitter: window=1715554300-1715554360 no_input=true, skipping emit (reason=no_input)`
mike_sre: that pattern means emitter omitted the datapoint instead of emitting 0. Console treats missing datapoints as gaps. Not a negative value, but creates a broken line and affects aggregations.
alex_chang: can you outline quick repro steps so eng can validate?
jordan_eng: repro steps:
1) create synthetic workload for route ingest-01
2) force kafka consumer rebalance (`kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server ... --execute --group acme-ingest-01 --reset-offsets --to-earliest` or simulate pod restart)
3) tail metrics-emitter logs and query /api/metrics with window=60s
expected: brief missing datapoint for that window unless emitter emits explicit 0
tara_support: customer also flagged billing anomalies because downstream aggregator treated the missing window as lower token total and caused price calc hiccup. they opened ticket #3234.
jordan_eng: short-term fix: change emitter to emit explicit 0. Long-term: make Console treat missing as 0 for active routes or backfill gaps during short rebalances. I'll prototype emitter change in a branch.
mike_sre: suggestion: canary the change to a single pod (where partition moved) and monitor synthetic token stream for 10m. Also add monitor that detects >1min consecutive null windows on a route.
alex_chang: assign owners and ETA?
jordan_eng: taking ownership for emitter patch, ETA ~3h for PR + canary. Will open PR 4021.
mike_sre: I'll own rollout and monitor, and implement temporary backfill script to insert zeros for last 5 minutes for affected routes.
tara_support: will message customer with ETA and workaround: manual backfill endpoint `/support/backfill?org=acmehr&route=ingest-01&range=5m` (internal only). Updated ticket #3234.
jordan_eng: pushed PR to branch `emit-zero-on-noinput`, deployed canary to pod-12. New logs: `metrics-emitter: emitted tokens_per_sec=0.0 for window=1715554320-1715554380 (reason=no_input)`
ingest-bot: alert monitor.tokens-per-sec-gap.acmehr fired at 1715554510; notifications sent to #oncall.
mike_sre: dashboards showing continuous series now on canary. I'll run a 30m smoke to ensure no regressions.
tara_support: AcmeHR confirmed charts look continuous after backfill/canary. Marking interim resolved, keeping ticket open until postmortem.
alex_chang: good. We'll schedule a brief postmortem and RFC to change default behavior: emit 0 for active route windows and add backfill pipeline. Owners: eng-runtime (jordan_eng), eng-sre (mike_sre), support (tara_support).
